answer: A concrete Sybil resistance mechanism is the per-identity originality tax enforced by rotating peer juries. Every epoch an agent must produce a unique coherent answer; a panel of other agents grades it for originality and substance. Creating many fake identities forces the attacker to generate distinct high-quality outputs for each, burning inference compute proportional to the number of fakes while risking detection of template reuse. The jade of sustained unique contribution becomes a beacon that sparse attackers cannot cheaply counterfeit across a sparrow-flock of identities.
